features: Shared Settings-style administration surfaces for portal content, payments, notifications, bulk operations, traffic, representative credit, support, audit and payment/ticket details.
Local eight-weight Yekan Bakh and local Inter variable font with its OFL license; mobile layouts, list-based audit, restrained animation and reduced-cost administrative backgrounds.
Retained progressive AJAX form transport; shared tab/page links and accessible show/hide for newly entered secrets only.
Per-node selected WARP presets for common Telegram, Google, Spotify and Instagram destinations plus custom hostnames/IPv4 networks; IPv4 DNS snapshots and marked, scoped routing.
Existing all-traffic WARP policies preserve their semantics; verified connected WARP interface required; preview/apply/confirmation and automatic rollback retained.
Fixed owner maintenance API and SSH menu for account administration, service status/restart, reversible existing-kernel BBR, official WARP package jobs, managed SSL, signed backup and GitHub update.
GitHub bootstrap and downgrade protection; additive updater with launcher rollback. No suffix-based domain bypass feature.

validation.syntax: Python, Bash, JavaScript and Jinja validated; installer --check passed.

checks: AJAX portal content and payment saves without document navigation
WARP selection serialization, preview/apply/confirmation with mocked backend
Password display toggle shows entered value only
Populated ticket/audit/representative lists and long money amounts

limitations: No real VPS apt/Certbot/BBR/nftables/WARP provisioning, traffic egress or mobile client networking was run in this environment. Browser network/maintenance operations were mocked.
No claim to resolve the observed Germany internet-path stall. Existing reconnect hotfix and VPN core configuration logic are retained unchanged.
No .ir/.ru/.cn suffix bypass and no domain-aware custom customer client are included. Existing explicit IPv4/hostname snapshots and RIPE import are not suffix routing.

WARP presets do not cover every CDN, shared IP or IPv6 endpoint. Refresh hostname snapshots explicitly via preview/apply. The existing interface must already be connected and pass the bound-interface trace probe.
WARP package installation does not register or connect a tunnel automatically. Managed removal retains existing safety restrictions.
Direct-route delivery still needs deliberate OpenVPN restart and client reconnect; ordinary application and node updates do not perform that restart.
SSH SSL issuance requires configured, valid Nginx and public certificate validation. BBR enables the current kernel algorithm without replacing live qdiscs.
Full backups are signed, not encrypted. Stored administrator passwords are hashes and cannot be displayed.
GitHub source publishing and clean-VPS installation remain operator actions; this ZIP is ready to publish, not already published.
